display.purpose: Expedition title; 48px override in short landscape.

heading.purpose: Help, map, pause, and result headings; 20px on narrow/short layouts.

body.purpose: Default HTML text and inherited control typography.

label.purpose: Form labels and supporting interface text.

components.name: Command button
components.description: Flat square command control with visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared start, resume, and retry treatment.

components.name: Seed field
components.description: Quiet label over a native square text field.

components.name: Keyboard selector
components.description: Native selection control used in the wrapping setup form.

components.name: Game toolbar
components.description: Compact native text buttons, enlarged for touch and short landscape.
components.css: .ds-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-tools button{font:700 12px/1.5 "Courier New",monospace;color:var(--paper,#eeeee4);background:#111;border:1px solid #3c3c36;border-radius:0;min-height:36px;padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer}.ds-tools button:hover{background:#242420}.ds-tools button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange,#ffa64b);outline-offset:4px}.ds-tools button:disabled{color:#77776d;cursor:default}@media(pointer:coarse),(max-width:760px){.ds-tools{gap:4px}.ds-tools button{min-height:44px}}@media(max-width:420px){.ds-tools button{padding:6px 8px}}@media(max-height:500px) and (min-width:600px) and (max-width:1000px){.ds-tools button{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Touch command groups
components.description: Zero-minimum D-pad tracks and a separate six-action grid; preview shows the mobile arrangement.
components.css: .ds-touch{display:grid;grid-template-columns:152px 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}.ds-touch button{font:700 11px/1.5 "Courier New",monospace;color:var(--paper,#eeeee4);background:#111;border:1px solid #66665e;border-radius:0;min-height:48px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}.ds-touch button:hover{border-color:var(--paper,#eeeee4);background:#242420}.ds-touch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange,#ffa64b);outline-offset:4px}.ds-dpad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px}.ds-dpad button{padding:4px 2px;min-width:0}.ds-up,.ds-down{grid-column:2}.ds-left{grid-column:1}.ds-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px}.ds-actions button{padding:6px 3px}@media(max-width:420px){.ds-touch{grid-template-columns:140px minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px}}@media(max-height:500px) and (min-width:600px) and (max-width:1000px){.ds-touch{grid-template-columns:140px minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px;margin:0}}

narrative.overview:
Black space, thin magenta chamber edges, diagonal steps, and small limited-color figures define the world. The surrounding HTML is a quiet command surface, not a dashboard. Original pixel artwork honors the supplied Apple II visual grammar without copying its title illustration.

This records the built `index.html` and `game.js`, reviewed against the supplied desktop, portrait, and landscape captures. Product and adaptation facts remain in PRODUCT.md and README.md.
keyCharacteristics: Three-tier black chambers with thin magenta structure.
Original pixel figures and alternating green/white stairs.
Compact inventory plus readable HTML commands and status.
Square controls, flat surfaces, and restrained monospaced type.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Keep the five named HTML colors aligned with the canvas palette; the two implementations currently use identical values.

rules.name: The HTML Readability Rule
rules.body: Do not rely on the scaled canvas HUD alone on mobile; preserve the HTML status, map descriptions, and field guide.

dos: **Do** preserve black chambers, thin magenta tiers, and green/white stairs.
**Do** keep figures small and inventory integrated into the playfield.
**Do** retain readable HTML help/status and separated touch-control groups.
**Do** keep original artwork and the shared HTML/canvas palette.
donts: **Don't** add gradients, dashboard chrome, shadows, or copied title artwork.
**Don't** replace the command-driven exploration with decorative UI.
**Don't** enlarge pixel figures into an unrelated illustration style.
**Don't** treat this adaptation as a pixel-exact remake or fully screen-reader-playable game.
